newsitem.title: USA: Investor raises ASV stake to 6.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Investor raises ASV stake to 6.9 pct.

text.p: James Dahl, an investor from Jacksonville, Fla., said Friday he raised his stake in ASV Inc to 6.9 percent or 222,600 common shares.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Dahl said he bought 38,600 additional shares of ASV between July 31 and September 18 at prices ranging from $14.625 to $18.875 a share.
Dahl, who is president of a private investment firm, said he holds the stake for investment purposes.
